name: Parsley-Parmesan Fries
desc: Oven-baked russet fries finished with Parmesan and fresh parsley.

source.evidence: Searched Parmesan parsley oven fries (Budget Bytes, Food.com, Southern Plate, Evolving Table); none uses this oil, salt, and Parmesan ratio at 400°F for 50 to 55 minutes.

ingredients.raw: 4 medium russet potatoes (about 2 1/2 lb), scrubbed and cut into 1/2-inch-thick fries

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment.
Toss the potatoes with the oil and salt in a large bowl, then spread them in a single layer on the sheet.
Bake 25 minutes, turn the fries, and bake 20 to 25 minutes more, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Sprinkle with the Parmesan and bake 5 minutes more, until the cheese melts. Toss with the parsley and serve hot.
tips: Budget Bytes bakes similar fries at 425°F for about 30 minutes; this version goes lower and longer.

references.title: Oven Baked Garlic Parmesan Fries
references.usedFor: 1/2-inch fry cut, parchment-lined sheet, parsley and Parmesan finish
